fields.title: Week of Oct 26 – Nov 1
fields.headline: $263K GMV in four sessions, 99% of target; the Shopee payday live missed badly.
fields.body:
**GMV: $263,200 of $265,000 (99%)** across four sessions.

**At risk**
- **Payday sale live** (Shopee, Oct 28): audio dropped for 25 minutes and the voucher never went live; 58% of target.

**Watch**
- **Halloween bundle live** (TikTok Shop): refunds still settling; cracked-glass complaints rising.

**Best**
- **Night-cream launch** (Douyin, Nov 1): 108% of target, the base for the Double 11 plan.

fields.title: Week of Nov 2 – Nov 8
fields.headline: $313K GMV in three sessions; 3 sessions at risk and 2 Double 11 sessions go live without all their stock.
fields.body:
**GMV: $313,000 of $310,000 (101%)** across three sessions. **10 of 16** sessions on the desk are on track.

**At risk**
- **Double 11 pre-sale, final hours** — Taobao Live, Nov 10, score 48. 2,000 serums held at customs until Nov 12. Action: cap the pre-sale at 8,000 units, by Nov 10.
- **Serum restock live** — Taobao Live, Nov 4, score 44. Sold out at minute 40; 1,900 orders waitlisted. Action: ship or refund by Nov 13.
- **Payday sale live** — Shopee, Oct 28, score 32. Checklist fixed; no repeat expected.

**Going live in 7 days, not ready**
- **Double 11 pre-sale** (Nov 10): 80% of stock.
- **11.11 flash-sale live** (Nov 11): 90% of stock. Action: transfer 300 cleansers from Singapore.

**Overdue**
- The candle carton switch was due Nov 6 — Black Friday candles ship from the same 3PL on Nov 14.

**Decisions for Monday**
1. Approve the 8,000-unit cap on the Taobao pre-sale.
2. Approve the Singapore → Jakarta transfer.
3. Get the double-wall carton spec signed today.
